title: Multi-attentive question answering over knowledge base
abstract: As a representative application in artificial intelligence (AI), knowledge-based question answering (KBQA) can transform human language into computer-readable language and answer users' questions through the knowledge graph, but much important information will be lost and ignored during the process. My research aims to develop a KBQA system applying deep learning methods to save more information during the transformation process. Compared with state-of-the-art models, our proposed models achieve competitive results in the SimpleQuestions dataset.
